diagnosis.why_small_n_loses: The complete provenance/firewall/capsule/tamper bookkeeping has a large approximately linear fixed-per-generator payload. At small n that overhead is larger than PR190's quadratic full-generator verification cost.
diagnosis.why_large_n_wins: PR190 repeatedly pays full-formula/full-generator work that scales quadratically on this factorized family, while the reverse candidate uses sparse local factors, one-pass ownership and local return capsules; the latter grows approximately linearly in the measured proxy over the frozen range.
diagnosis.observed_crossover: Between n=32 and n=64 in the frozen measurements; this is an empirical proxy crossover, not a complexity theorem.
diagnosis.important_result: The complete reverse architecture is correctness-preserving and becomes substantially cheaper than PR190 at larger frozen n, but the preregistered all-n promotion gate correctly prevents KEEP.

claim_boundary: This STOP is a preserved negative result under the frozen all-n improvement gate.
The n>=64 cost advantage is restricted-family evidence only.
The work proxy mixes charged structural operations and explicitly serialized/hash payload bytes and is not a machine-instruction runtime theorem.
The factorized equality family exposes local structure that arbitrary CNFs may not possess.
No result here establishes polynomial decomposition discovery or polynomial quotient size for arbitrary CNFs.
